document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You’re in section-K. The stairs go up; large steps designed for large 
beings. Obscene drawings of foul creatures decorate the walls: 
entities with slimy open pustules for eye sockets, and covered in 
gaping mouths everywhere. In the drawings, they use captive humans 
for lewd pleasures, and perhaps for something more substantial: 
your shock requires a Sanity roll; lose 0/1D3 Sanity points. If you 
successfully make a Spot Hidden, go to 349. You then enter section-I 
(insert that puzzle piece into the pyramid outline); go to 313.
(332)
